'''Garreck Darkmere''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the younger brother of [[Evram Darkmere]].

==Biography==
Darkmere's mother was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and when he was a child, she was killed during a conflict between the [[Daupherm Planet States]] and the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]], so he entered the care of his older brother. However, two years later, Evram joined the [[Daupherm Merchant Space Fleet|Daupherm Merchant Fleet]], so Garreck had to go and live in a [[Daupherm/Legends|Daupherm]] orphanage.
